gaps.claim: rewards.posts.read_at enters the payload hash, so every quiet console poll makes the committed dashboard stale against a render (rule 12 red between polls).
vendor_news counts the first-seen vendor_status of a report we just filed ourselves, so our own filing wakes a sweep as their news.
'their side moved:' prints the last three vendor events ever, not those since the last sweep, and prints on a night-rule sweep no news triggered.
inside a declaring '## PICKS' heading every naming line is picked until the next heading, ruled-out/excluded names included.
a plan-derived kind that is not a product (arena) now yields product None instead of falling through; the old `in KIND_PRODUCT` guard was dropped.
a regression whose `at` does not parse is dropped, so reopen is never owed for it where the old code owed it for any fall.
the reopen replay orders a fall against the filing timeline by ISO string compare, the '+' vs '.' ordering _instant fixes in the fold.
json-parses every run record newer than the last full run on each render; unbounded when no full run for days.
the Rewards hero adds bug rewards in rw.currency to posts.et10 under one currency label.
the numbered-list fallback takes the first name of every numbered line as a pick, numbered exclusions included.

our own filing's first vendor_status (bounty.py:631 appends when a report id first appears) counts as their news (qa/lab.py:671) and wakes a sweep; the test's 'ours' event is a filing_outcome, never counted anyway. Replay: seq 2759 '#129 pending' by agent. Same as R02.

said['tracker'] is read by nothing: a tracker read failing every tick yields no gap and decide none (this morning's QA_WALLET_ADDRESS shape); the stub only returns ok and vendor_seq==7 is the stub's constant.
a vendor a2a message with no `auto` key (unknown per bounty.py:475) is treated as a person's reply; the fixture gives auto False where the real row has no key.
every job in the test is 2h10m old, so a POLLABLE_HOURS window shrunk to 3h still passes; six 10-hour-old jobs would stop counting and a seventh question go out.

brief() prints OUR-0001 under 'his proposals, best earner first' (scripts/lab.py:3522); the test's 'question for him' string is on every brief, so the OUR rooms section could vanish and the test stay green.
the reading before the window and the first inside it both carry 30.0 (test:3089), so the STR-0034 defect (first reading overall) gives the same 112.5.
the '60% of the book alone' limit is never exercised: restart_affordable is not driven through bot_variants with a book over it.
the fixture's only bot is not trading, so the 'trading' chip is never drawn; a page that never shows a trading bot passes.
signals at 88 and 12 only, so any conviction cutoff between 12 and 88 passes; no signal at 69/70 pins the operator's 70.
the no-get_usage guard scans only laborator/SKILL.md; docs/laborator-plan.md:75 still says get_usage is read before each phase.

LINKS is hard-coded to /creator/tg_expire76/links while the leads are now read with the trusted key (account expire76); reply slugs claimed by expire76 (505, 462, 503, 529, ...) are not in tg_expire76's list, so the next run fails on our own mismatch.

(a) probe is capped at MAX_PROBES=120 and run 195840Z hit the cap, so a pass can leave later candidates unprobed; (b) a 429/5xx probe counts as 'refused' and a non-200 page/script is dropped silently, so a rate-limited run passes (rule 8).

passes on one card closed on both surfaces for any reason (reason recorded, never consulted), while stock-leg cards can sit in `unread` and out of the verdict -- the market-hours gate the docstring names is not exercised.
a history answering 200 with no points (or renamed keys) is added to `judged` with no jumps, so an empty read counts toward a pass.
inconclusive only when every profile is unread: 2 of 3 unread and 1 read without an offer passes as 'the offer is gone'; only live[:3] is sampled.
a probe answering 5xx/401 matches neither branch and drops out of `served`, so a route that failed to answer is judged as absent and the check can pass on the rest.
the hook's stdout is never asserted on the broken-files run; an unconditional print after exec_module stays green.
the index is compared only when both sides are numbers: page $1.23 against an API null index_price_usd is skipped and passes.
'not skipped' is read from decorators only; a pytest.skip() in the body or module-level pytestmark skip leaves in_force True.
the tripwire covers _surface_facts() alone; facts() changed to call surface_drift() directly stays green.
TILE.search judges only the first write to the tile; a later refresh writing funded+building passes.

removing the `outcome != 'accepted'` filter at qa/fold.py:766 leaves all 1058 meta tests green (auditor ran it in memory): an `unknown` fail would clear reopen and an `unknown` pass verification_owed; every _verification() fixture is accepted.

neither check_fingerprint nor helpers_fingerprint covers module constants (WINDOW, OTHER_STAGES, TILE, SETTING_BOUNDS), so a constant changed to make a check pass keeps both hashes, and verify.py tells the vendor the check was not rewritten; transitivity of helper hashing is also unproven.

the test reads only the source between '# --- the night' and 'def main(' plus bounty; the night reaches _archive_diaries and, via _sibling, keep/processes/morning/clone, where a git commit or subprocess stays green.
REPLY_URL['twitter'] accepts any account's status URL, including the thread's own tweet (CLAIMED permalink x.com/LuxAlgo/status/...), the X twin of the reddit thread URL the test refuses.
_settle returns any claimed lead with that id without comparing reply_page_slug to the page asked for, and reads back with limit 200 so a committed claim past the 200th reads 'not claimed'.
asserts grid <= SAFE_SETTINGS plus a fixed forbidden list; is_paper added to MARKET_TOGGLES and components.yaml together stays green and a PATCH could flip a clone to live.
the 2026-09-09 decision owns the /channels table row, but the row sits outside the hashed paragraph; changing it to high stays green.
_assignment skips `+=`, so `let nb = s.building||0; nb += s.funded||0; text(tile, nb)` resolves to s.building and the check passes while the tile shows funded+building (verified).
the path [100,103,109,95] has one round past 8%, so peak or last-past-8% exits also give 9.0.
the real caller passes went_in.get(instance) or 0.0 (scripts/lab.py:2734); a clone whose fund outcome was unknown counts 0, so every restart fits under the 60% ceiling (paper money).
the rule check is a superset check on executable_params and ignores inert_params, so the transport wall can widen unseen (body itself pinned). Cosmetic.
the docstring promises a one-line description per test; nothing asserts it. Cosmetic.
TOOL_VERBS is a fixed list so 'with `rebalance_portfolio`' is not extracted; the docstring owns the choice. Cosmetic.
